message: 物欲まみれでも約束
Maybe I'll try studying somewhere quiet today for a change of pace.
Even though this isn't the time to be leisurely drinking black tea...

name: Azel
message: 「So this is a Leica...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. This is a Leica. It's a model called the Leica M3.」

name: Azel
message: 「Does it work?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It had been stored away in the back of the warehouse for a long time, but when I checked it yesterday, it operated properly.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's an old model.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed. It requires quite a bit of effort to use.」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's positively antiquated... Going out of one's way to use a machine like this is pure eccentricity...」
Even as she said that, Azel was happily caressing the old-fashioned camera all over.
The fact that she hasn't touched her black tea is probably proof of how engrossed she is.

name: Azel
message: 「Where is the monitor?」

name: Synn
message: 「This one doesn't have one.」

name: Azel
message: 「What?! You can't tell what kind of photo you took right on the spot?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not a digital camera, after all. You won't know until you get it developed.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I know about developing. That's common knowledge.」

name: Synn
message: 「What about exposure, photosensitivity, and aperture?」

name: Azel
message: 「O-Of course that's common knowledge too.」
Still as competitive as ever, I see.
Truth be told, I don't really know much about them myself, though.

name: Azel
message: 「Would you mind if I borrowed it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It would be wise to also borrow a book explaining how to take photographs and how to operate the camera.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I'll be fine without such things.」

name: Azel
message: 「However... allow me to borrow them just in case.」
She really hasn't changed at all.
Even so.

name: Synn
message: 「You sure seem relaxed, Azel. Are you going to be okay for the regular exams?」

name: Melilot
message: 「What about you, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uh, well, so-so...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're a scholarship student, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, ah, w-well... Yes, I'm grateful for the support.」
I shrink back.
Ah, is it bad that I'm drinking tea in a place like this?

name: Azel
message: 「What is a midterm exam?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat?! No way?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Midterm exams are meant to make the students of this academy realize their own academic standing.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Furthermore, those whose test results show academic ability unworthy of this academy will be assigned mandatory remedial classes to bring them up to the proper standard.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. You were panicking because there is a possibility your grades will be deemed unworthy of a student here. Understood.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I don't think it'll be that bad, though...」

name: Azel
message: 「Then there is no problem. Why are you cowering?」

name: Synn
message: 「Agh, seriously! Must be nice being so carefree, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「Carefree?」

name: Synn
message: 「Your grades are fine, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Irrelevant.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... the exams are?」

name: Azel
message: 「I will not take them.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's no good at all.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」
Whoa. Those are serious eyes.

name: Synn
message: 「Which means, Azel-san... you haven't studied or anything, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」
It's hopeless. Azel really intends not to take the exams!

name: Melilot
message: 「I see. Understood.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? You're going to allow it!? Even though you're a faculty member!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will lend you the Leica once Azel-san's test results come out.」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-what did you say!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course, it will have to be a result befitting a student of the academy.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The books are also on hold for now.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... I-I don't really need to borrow them anyway.」

name: Melilot
message: 「What about the Leica?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I have a digital camera!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is unfortunate. It's something I don't use anymore, so I was thinking I might lend it to you.」

name: Azel
message: 「W-w-what!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Perhaps I should just sell it to a secondhand shop or something.」

name: Azel
message: 「W-wait!」

name: Azel
message: 「When is this test of yours!」

name: Synn
message: 「Next week, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hold off on selling it until the test is over.」

name: Melilot
message: 「So you will take the test?」

name: Azel
message: 「Th-that's not what I meant, just wait.」
She intends to take it.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's have a study session with everyone before the test.」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you study properly for the test, I'll treat you to ramen.」
Azel's eyes darted around in midair.
Pride and desire are probably locked in a stalemate right now.

name: Azel
message: 「I'll eat. I'll study.」
That was easy!

name: Synn
message: 「Then, after school, at the library. Okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「Understood.」
Still, Azel, are you sure you're okay with this?
A Leica and ramen. Purely driven by materialistic desires starting with 'ra'.

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, I shall wait until the test results come out.」

name: Azel
message: 「You will lend it to me, then?」

name: Melilot
message: 「As long as you meet the required score. Shall we draw up a contract?」

name: Azel
message: 「No, that's fine. I'm sure you two will keep your promise.」
She just said 'you two', didn't she.
She thinks even I'm the kind of person who keeps their promises.
In other words, doesn't that mean she trusts me?

name: Azel
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's nothing.」
I felt a little happy.
